caption: The drawing depicts two garments side by side on a plain background. On the left is a short-sleeved dress that is a reddish-brown color, gathered at the waist with a full skirt. The dress features decorative bands at the hem and sleeve edges that are multicolored, displaying geometric patterns with shades of green, blue, red, yellow, and orange. On the right is a matching reddish-brown jacket with wide, elbow-length sleeves and a flared, open front. The jacket has similar multicolored geometric patterned trim along the collar, down the front edges, around the hem, and at the sleeve cuffs. Both garments are painted in a realistic style, showing shading and fabric folds. The background is an unadorned off-white color.
title: Child's Dress and Jacket
